description: Co. Louth Road Schedule is a dataset listed in Ireland national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Louth County Council. This dataset contains details on all roads within County Louth. The dataset was derived from Ordnance Survey Road centre-line data, along with road classifications lists and Louth County Council, Dundalk Town Council and Drogheda Borough Council Roads in Charge records. Coverage: Louth County Council. The portal files it under the publisher Louth County Council. Its tags are louth, road, road network, traffic infrastructure, transport. It offers 1 resource(s) in HTML. The portal shows 2026-09-22 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ie-portal.
